basis: Accelerated-phase myeloid leukemia directly affects marrow and blood cells; cytopenias and leukocytosis are defining manifestations.
Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism; olfactory loss in 2/3 and osteopenia in 2/3 support neurologic and skeletal involvement.
Urea-cycle metabolic disorder; hyperammonemic encephalopathy and hepatic dysfunction are common across symptomatic forms, estimated >=30%; severity varies across subtypes.
Insulin resistance/lipodystrophy, Rieger anomaly and skeletal abnormalities define SHORT; hearing loss 80-99%; skin/subcutaneous fat and dental abnormalities omitted by cap.
Broad thoracic tumor umbrella includes lung and pleural origins; pulmonary is the closest regional axis. Cardiac, chest-wall and other origins depend on subtype.
Nonsyndromic postaxial polydactyly is a congenital skeletal limb malformation.
FUS-related motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting reflects denervation rather than a primary muscle disease.
Sudden loss of sensorineural hearing defines an auditory disorder; heterogeneous possible causes do not establish additional axes.
Atherosclerotic plaque affects the renal artery; renal parenchymal dysfunction is not inherent and ischemic nephropathy is a separate disease.
Fluid-filled obstructed fallopian tube is confined to a reproductive organ; infection is not required by the definition.
Aspartoacylase deficiency causes leukodystrophy; optic atrophy occurs in 80-99% and hearing impairment in 30-79%; reflux is a separate condition.
Chromosomal neurodevelopmental syndrome with intellectual and speech impairment; hypotonia does not establish muscle disease. Obesity alone adds no direct endocrine damage.
Leukodystrophy, acquired microcephaly and severe developmental impairment define CNS disease; nystagmus alone does not establish ocular damage.
Paraneoplastic bilateral uveal melanocytic proliferation directly damages vision; the associated malignancy is a separate disease and immune mediation is insufficiently established.
Familial heat-induced urticaria is a mast-cell-mediated skin disorder; cutaneous wheals are the defining disease manifestation.
Malignant fibroblastic tumor arises in deep soft connective tissues; no additional organ occupation is inherent.
Developmental reading disorder affects neural processing of written language; it is a neurodevelopmental disorder rather than an eye disorder.
Intestinal tapeworm infection directly occupies the gut; clinically significant B12-deficiency anemia occurs in a small minority, below 30%.
Carcinoma originates in the prostate, a reproductive organ outside the axes; urinary invasion or obstruction is not inherent.
Demodex infestation causes inflammation of cutaneous hair follicles.
Non-proliferative fibrocystic change is confined to breast tissue, which has no axis.
Neurodevelopmental impairment and ocular anomalies define the syndrome; skeletal involvement includes kyphosis in 2/2 and hip subluxation/camptodactyly in 1/2.
Systemic inflammatory rheumatic syndrome; arthralgia, transient exanthem and reactive leukocytosis alone do not establish joint, skin or blood damage.
Immune-mediated CNS demyelination with encephalopathy; visual loss and respiratory failure occur in only 5-29%.
Sleep-wake disorder defined by impaired regulation of wakefulness and excessive sleepiness.
